summary.text: Ron Frederick is the Republican candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives District 26A in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Eric Emery (D).
Frederick previously ran for the same seat in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Ron Frederick first ran for District 26A in 2022, when he lost the Republican primary to Joyce Glynn, 223 votes to 277.
In 2024 he was the Republican nominee and lost the general election to incumbent Eric Emery (D), receiving 30.2% of the vote to Emery's 51.1%; independent William Lafferty received 18.7%.
Ballotpedia lists him as having signed the U.S. Term Limits Pledge in 2024.
